purpose: Targeted fulltext/abstract audit of source studies outside the biased first wave of Zenodo Netherlands GPS; these are NOT an exhaustive systematic review or a quantitative meta.

papers.endpoint: GPS habitat-selection with diel and tide strata
papers.source_n: 20 GPS-tagged birds, four nested coastal regions
papers.data_access_status: Movebank study 696824680 reported by authors; underlying download and license unverified
papers.published_pattern: large intertidal area selected during low tides; distinct daytime, nighttime and high tide choices
papers.key_limit: 4 regions are nested within a single source study and 20 tagged birds; no independent region p-values yet

papers.endpoint: acoustic receiver migration timing, six acceleration tags
papers.source_n: 34 tagged, 33 detected, 90,107 original acoustic detections; six acceleration tags
papers.tide_solar_status: both tide and day/night across non-tidal and tidal water
papers.data_access_status: European Tracking Network original DOI identified, raw time series not yet admitted
papers.published_pattern: non-tidal river nocturnal movement shifts to ebb-linked migration in tidal reaches
papers.key_limit: river reach changes current, turbidity, depth and acoustic receiver detection; one basin not separate coast replicates

papers.endpoint: camera trap photo-sequence activity × low tide time and coastal distance
papers.source_n: over five years of camera traps 2017-2023; exact independent groups and camera deployments to audit
papers.tide_solar_status: tide and diurnal time, group tool-use contrast
papers.data_access_status: figshare supplemental research collection published; original observations and effort need audit
papers.published_pattern: tool-using group coastal activity more consistently tide-associated than non-tool groups
papers.key_limit: camera detection not feeding; tide proxy comes from island ~90 km away; single island, near coast tool use only one stretch

papers.endpoint: fish sound events and types, visual fish counts
papers.source_n: 26 sound types vs 19 visually recorded species; number of independent acoustic sites must be audited
papers.data_access_status: supplement XLSX includes acoustic, environmental and underwater visual survey analysis datasets
papers.published_pattern: low water has more fish acoustic activity, but high water has higher visual fish abundance
papers.key_limit: sounds are not counts of individual fish; shared hydrophone effort, ambient flow masking and species identities uncertain

papers.endpoint: visual count by species and habitat at standardized tide
papers.tide_solar_status: day/night contrast not sampled, exclude from primary tide×solar meta
papers.data_access_status: published Table 1 tide coefficients and SE; raw survey rows not confirmed
papers.published_pattern: low tide mudflat use rises; high tide beach roosting rises; feeding rates did not have clear tidal dependence
papers.key_limit: all three species are one survey coast and correlated; β tide conditional on mean standardized wind because tide×wind interaction; only morning sampling

papers.endpoint: reproductive lunar timing, larval elevation/genetic assignment, modelled coexistence
papers.source_n: Roscoff two sympatric temporal strains; original field sample sizes require audit
papers.tide_solar_status: lunar spring-neap and low tide, indirect diel timing
papers.data_access_status: EDMOND repository full data/code DOI in paper; not downloaded
papers.published_pattern: full moon vs new moon emergence differences produce higher vs lower spawning waterlines, larval spatial separation and coexistence model
papers.key_limit: modelled coexistence not experimentally demonstrated coexistence causation; same Roscoff system linked to later Jacobsen 2026 paper

papers.endpoint: individual-based simulated allochronic divergence under larval space competition
papers.source_n: simulated 500 generations in example, not new field cohort
papers.data_access_status: original model code is public; no independent new field animals
papers.published_pattern: competition with timing-mediated larval spatial segregation can drive sympatric timing divergence in simulations
papers.key_limit: same Clunio Roscoff source hypotheses as prior study; cannot count as an independent biological replicate

papers.endpoint: laboratory activity rhythmicity under ALAN treatment
papers.source_n: marine/freshwater amphipod comparison across laboratory light intensity regimes
papers.tide_solar_status: ALAN/light only, not genuine field tide×solar
papers.data_access_status: paper reports public experimental research data; exact original source rows not audited
papers.published_pattern: ALAN treatments alter rhythmicity and nocturnality in marine intertidal amphipod, compared with freshwater species
papers.key_limit: exclude from field tide-response meta and from autonomous circatidal clock proof

papers.endpoint: aboveground density and feeding habitat by day/night and season
papers.source_n: Shigenobu and Awai estuaries two distinct stations in same study
papers.tide_solar_status: diel contrasts documented, sampled tide phase not confirmed
papers.data_access_status: journal freely accessible but no original time series/SE extracted
papers.published_pattern: two co-occurring species differ in diel behavior, food and mudflat use
papers.key_limit: do not infer a tide-phase effect from day/night seasonal sampling

papers.endpoint: GPS or survey habitat use candidate; true UTC & tide/solar coverage unverified
papers.data_access_status: Dryad DOI source known but no raw/time audit
papers.key_limit: no source-verified field tide/diel effect, independent geography candidate only
